behavior_change_from_previous: a minor release on 0.40.0: a bracket holding only digits, hyphens, and commas is a list of numbers and ranges in every selector (--target, --site, --device-group, --select-platform, --exclude, target files, job list --target, the credential CSV's selector columns, and the credential-policy-map, session-init-map, and ssh-algorithms-map rules), matching exactly the names it spells at its lower bound's width, a malformed one refused target_selector_pattern_invalid, credential_csv_row_invalid, or config_match_rule_pattern_invalid; a target holding a range creates the names it spells in written order, an inventory device or else a direct target, bounded by targets.max-created-names (1 to 100,000, default 1000), target_created_names_exceeded (exit 4); targets.inventory-only refuses a name the inventory lacks, target_not_in_inventory (exit 5), a range or glob under it selecting; --inventory, --inv, or --i sets it for the invocation, and --inv=FILE makes the files given the run's whole inventory; --tl splits outside brackets only; a configured source named direct is an inventory source; security.require-fips is removed (config_unknown_key, config_unknown_environment), the audit's policy without fips_required; karvi version, its JSON, and a job manifest's app.build have no fips_mode; karvi-sysutil makes, repairs, and removes the service account's configuration as the account and refuses a link or another owner's file in its place, and stops when it cannot write its record; the release's number is written once, in VERSION; the shell-script review's fixes to the suites and scripts (each script ended at a signal with its cleanup run once, a Ctrl-C stopping every lane, the suites reading JSON by its path and refusing a configured host, the bundle's modes 0644 and 0755 whatever the umask, tar failures stopping the bundle and the package, the Makefile's smoke targets removed); configuration registry 34 and audit 4 move, every other counter is 0.40.0's (configuration schema 6, daemon IPC 12, job manifest and summary 5, execution plan 17, command record 5, plan report 4, credential package 2, scoreboard 5); Go and every module are 0.40.0's; the first submission after the upgrade drains a 0.40.0 daemon; see CHANGELOG.md

build.dependencies: vendored (go.mod, go.sum, vendor/); built with no network

daemon_upgrade_recovery.job_submission_schema: exact-current-only (the client's IPC schema and build)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.automatic_replacement: a client launching its own daemon (daemon.launch client) drains a daemon of another build at its own schema: idle, it exits and the client starts its own in the same invocation; busy, it finishes its jobs and exits after the last, each submission meanwhile refused daemon_draining (exit 112); a service account's daemon (daemon.launch systemd) is never drained by a client, and its unit is restarted
daemon_upgrade_recovery.incompatible_run_error: daemon_incompatible (a daemon of a newer IPC schema); daemon_draining (a drained daemon finishing its jobs)
daemon_upgrade_recovery.actual_lifecycle_replay: not run: the newest release whose daemon IPC schema (11) differs from this client's (12) is v0.29.0, whose daemon predates the drain that exits and listens on daemon.sock, which this client never reaches; the compatibility example ran before the number was committed: beside the released v0.40.0 daemon, at this client's schema and of another build, the client's daemon status stacked the two builds (compatible: false), its run's exercise drained the idle daemon and started its own (exit 0, no device contacted), and with the older daemon holding a job on the fake device the client's run was refused daemon_draining (exit 112), the daemon exiting after the job (evidence/ipc-schema-compat.log)
